acceptance: `make pr-preflight` runs the landing quickstarts check whenever the inputs that CI's check depends on have changed.
A stale quickstart fails preflight locally, with the regeneration command in the message.
description: `make pr-preflight` does not run `scripts/generate_landing_quickstarts.py --check`. A PR that changes platform manifests or deployment modes can pass local preflight and then fail in CI, which costs one CI round. This happened during the deployment-modes work (#2974).
